title: iRacing Circuit Guide: GR86 - Oulton Park - International

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake at start of jordanbikes.com advertising board
corners.mistakes: don't use white line as edge of track

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Downshift to third gear, use all the road on the outside.
corners.line: Turn in late, use all the apex curve available.
corners.exit: Full throttle by the time you're in line with the green and white striped fence, run wide on exit.
corners.mistakes: Using too much of the grated section on exit can bog the car down.

corners.braking: Brake after crest, as soon as crest finishes.
Brake just after the crest to third gear.
corners.exit: Start throttle pickup before apex, full throttle just before apex.
corners.mistakes: Avoid spending too long on the bumpy parts.

corners.braking: brake shape similar to turn one
corners.gear: same downshift point as turn one
corners.line: same on-off throttle technique as turn one

corners.label: T4
corners.line: smooth lift and smooth steering input
corners.exit: full throttle at the end of apex curb
corners.mistakes: overload the front wheels, scrub the front wheels, push understeer, no grip for the hairpin

corners.exit: Smooth throttle application to avoid overheating tires.
corners.mistakes: Over scrubbing the front tires, understeering.

corners.braking: end of tire bundle, straight steering, then brake
corners.mistakes: do not turn in early, avoid ABS

corners.braking: brake early, use all road on the outside
corners.mistakes: don't use late apex, don't cut back

corners.braking: Brake at second angle in tire wall, keep steering straight.
corners.line: Straighten steering wheel as you brake.
corners.mistakes: Following the curve of the road when braking.

corners.braking: Brake to the left curb without hitting the tire barrier.
corners.line: Take as much curb as possible, then change direction.
corners.mistakes: Avoid hitting the tire barrier on the right side.

corners.braking: Half a meter off the inside curve, brake early
corners.line: Turn-in early, aim for second apex

corners.braking: Between 100 and 50 m, hold brakes until second apex
corners.line: Middle of car to miss white line, aim for middle of car
corners.exit: Transition to throttle at second apex
corners.mistakes: Too much margin, missing white line

corners.braking: Brake reference is a curve in the road, hard to see.
corners.line: Short shift to 3rd, lift early, turn in and full throttle at apex.
corners.mistakes: Watch out for off-track trigger on the inside curb.

corners.line: maximize track usage on the outside
corners.mistakes: over push the entry, turn in late, understeer

corners.label: T2
corners.mistakes: brake on top of the crest

corners.braking: Brake assertively, trail brake into corner
corners.line: Rotate car to be full throttle by road

general_tips: white line is not edge of track
Use the grated stuff on the exit but it may bog the car.
stay off the grated stuff on exit
Be smooth with throttle and steering inputs.
Lift throttle if understeer is felt.
maximize braking capacity by avoiding steering input during braking
precision is key through the chicanes
focus on being precise to avoid barriers and maintain speed
Focus on the left side of the car for easier reference points.
Throttle application at second apex to make it look like one corner on data
